title: social-shots image plan (shots.json)
description: One file describes the whole set: brand, languages and one entry per image. All paths are relative to this file.

name.description: App name shown next to the icon.

bg.description: Gradient start, usually the dark brand color.

accent.description: Highlighted *words*, badge, glow. Must read well on bg.

muted.description: Subhead color. Defaults to text at 72% opacity.

fonts.description: Optional brand fonts (TTF/OTF/WOFF, not WOFF2). Default is Inter, which covers Latin, Latin-ext, Cyrillic, Greek and Vietnamese.

fallback.description: Extra font files tried for glyphs the main fonts lack, e.g. Noto Sans JP/KR/SC, Noto Sans Arabic, Noto Sans Thai.

output.description: Output folder, relative to this file. The --out flag (relative to the current directory) overrides it.

languages.description: Language codes; the first is the primary language.

mode.description: single: one set in `lang` → out/. multi: one set per language → out/<lang>/. bilingual: primary text + translation subtitles → out/<es+en>/.

lang.description: Language for single mode. Defaults to languages[0].

color.description: #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa or rgb(r,g,b). Theme tokens, hsl() and named colors are rejected.

text.description: A plain string (same in every language) or one string per language code.

screenshots.description: Screenshot paths. `{lang}` is replaced per language and falls back to the primary language, then to the path without the `{lang}/` segment. Or one list per language.

id.description: Output file name without extension. Unique.

template.description: hero: 1 phone. duo: 2 tilted phones. trio: 3 phones, middle featured. statement: icon + text, no phone.

badge.description: 1–3 words, rendered uppercase in a pill above the headline.

headline.description: 3–7 words. Wrap 1–3 words in *asterisks* to color them with the accent.

screenshots.description: Exactly 1 for hero, 2 for duo, 3 for trio, none for statement.
